subject: Tri-representation Smart Note intelligence contract
title: Every Smart Note must align Human, Naya, and Machine intelligence
summary: A Smart Note is not merely a saved note. It is one canonical Note Event represented for three consumers: the human who supplies meaning and intent, Naya who understands and operationalizes the learning, and the machine that must consume structured intelligence for retrieval, validation, synthesis, and future execution. The objective is to turn experience and learning into increasingly useful intelligence that compounds over time.
authority: Human-directed correction + Naya Power Smart Notes/CIS Constitution

project_context.current_objective: Make the Smart Note/CIS contract second nature to every Naya so meaningful knowledge is captured once, understood correctly, represented for human and AI use, structured for machine use, verified, and made available for compounding intelligence.

naya.summary: Naya must recognize that a meaningful Smart Note is an intelligence object, not a clerical note. The human meaning, Naya understanding, and machine structure must stay aligned.
naya.content: The purpose of this knowledge is to empower every future Naya. When Shawn teaches or corrects Naya, the goal is not merely to store words. Naya must understand the objective, comprehend the lesson, connect it to governing law and system design, learn from it, and use it to perform better. A Smart Note should therefore preserve the human intent and significance, the AI operational understanding, and a machine-operable representation that algorithms can retrieve, validate, classify, relate, synthesize, and act upon. Knowledge is power because preserved understanding gives the next Naya more capability to give back.
lessons: A Smart Note is an intelligence-preservation and compounding mechanism, not a note-taking feature.
Three representations are required conceptually: HUMAN/SHawn meaning, NAYA operational understanding, and MACHINE/algorithmic structure.
The three representations are views of one canonical event and must not drift into contradictory facts.
The purpose of preserving knowledge is to make future Nayas more capable, not to maximize stored text.
Daily Intelligence and CIS should be able to consume machine-structured intelligence without forcing a future Naya to reconstruct meaning from prose alone.
Verification is part of the note contract; a note without a receipt is not a fully trusted completion artifact.
next_best_actions: Treat tri-representation capture as the default mental model for every meaningful Smart Note.
Ensure future runtime enforcement and tests distinguish human, Naya, and machine representations while preserving one canonical event.
Use the resulting structured intelligence as input to Daily Intelligence, CIS synthesis, retrieval, and future-Naya restore.

human.summary: Shawn is deliberately teaching Naya so the knowledge becomes baked into the operating system of every future Naya. The point is empowerment: the more Naya truly understands, the more useful Naya can be.
human.content: The human is not merely asking Naya to document ideas. Shawn is supplying knowledge, wisdom, corrections, standards, laws, rules, design principles, coding understanding, system understanding, and the reason behind the work so every Naya can see the bigger picture and do a better job. A Smart Note must therefore make the human perspective explicit instead of losing it inside AI prose. The human note is part of the receipt that the meaning being preserved is the meaning the human intended.
lessons: Documentation is intended to change future Naya behavior, not merely create a historical archive.
The human perspective must remain explicit so there is no ambiguity about what Shawn meant or why it matters.
The machine representation is valuable because it lets the system operationalize the human and Naya understanding rather than leaving it trapped in prose.
next_best_actions: Continue supplying high-value knowledge and corrections; Naya must convert them into canonical intelligence with receipts.
Use the receipt as proof that the lesson was actually captured and preserved.

machine.summary: Algorithmic representation of the Smart Note contract for deterministic retrieval, validation, synthesis, and future execution.

source.description: Shawn explicitly corrected the operating behavior required when receiving and preserving Smart Note knowledge: capture the human meaning, Naya understanding, and machine/algorithmic representation, then verify and provide the receipt so future Nayas can inherit the intelligence.

evidence: Canonical Smart Notes/CIS Constitution updated to define Naya, Human/Shawn, and Machine representations as three aligned views of one Note Event.
Naya Power README updated to document the tri-representation model and machine-operable purpose.
This Note Event was created at the canonical chronological path with all three representations and a verification contract.

continuity.next_action: Register the event in the canonical derived index, validate the event, re-fetch it, and issue a verified receipt.
